requirements.quote: The CCD shall be so designed, constructed and assembled such that a vehicle fitted with the CCD conforms to the requirements of this Regulation
requirements.text: The close-coupling device shall be designed, constructed and assembled so that a vehicle fitted with it conforms to this Regulation under normal conditions of road use.

requirements.quote: The coupling devices themselves must comply with the technical requirements of Regulation No. 55. Additional forces which may be caused by the assembled CCD
requirements.text: The coupling device itself shall comply with the technical requirements of UN Regulation No. 55, taking into account additional forces caused by the assembled CCD in operation.

requirements.quote: The operation of the CCD shall be automatic. Even the reverse movement of the close-coupled combination must be possible without any manual action at the CCD.
requirements.text: The operation of the close-coupling device shall be automatic, and reverse movement of the close-coupled combination shall be possible without any manual action at the CCD.

requirements.quote: the CCD shall be so designed, constructed and assembled so as to be resistant to all stresses, corrosion and ageing to which it may be subjected
requirements.text: The CCD shall be designed, constructed and assembled to resist all stresses, corrosion and ageing to which it may be subjected, including vibration, humidity and extreme temperatures.

requirements.quote: The CCD shall enable vehicles to travel in a straight line on a level road, without any abnormal effort being applied to the steering control
requirements.text: The CCD shall enable the vehicles to travel in a straight line on a level road, forwards or in reverse, without abnormal effort on the steering control.

requirements.quote: Any power system failure and/or control system failure of the CCD, while the vehicle is running, shall cause the coupling to extend and remain in that position
requirements.text: When a power or control system failure of the CCD occurs while the vehicle is running, the coupling shall extend and remain in that position.

requirements.quote: Separation of the towing vehicle and trailer must be prevented by mechanical means under all conditions of use.
requirements.text: Separation of the towing vehicle and trailer shall be prevented by mechanical means under all conditions of use.

requirements.quote: Any power system and/or control system failure must be indicated to the driver by an acoustic and an optical signal.
requirements.text: Any power or control system failure of the CCD shall be indicated to the driver by both an acoustic and an optical signal.

requirements.quote: When the vehicles are stationary no uncontrolled movement of the CCD may occur under any circumstances including long term uphill parking.
requirements.text: When the vehicles are stationary, including during long-term uphill parking, no uncontrolled movement of the CCD shall occur.

requirements.quote: Non-automatic movement of the CCD may be possible only while the towing vehicle is stationary.
requirements.text: Non-automatic movement of the CCD shall be possible only while the towing vehicle is stationary.

requirements.quote: An instruction to apply the parking brake of the towing vehicle shall be permanently attached to the control unit.
requirements.text: An instruction to apply the parking brake of the towing vehicle shall be permanently attached to the control unit.

requirements.quote: This operation shall be controlled by means of a dual control unit.
requirements.text: Non-automatic movement of the CCD shall be controlled by means of a dual control unit.

requirements.quote: This control unit must be fitted outside the driver's cabin and shall be situated in such a position that the operator is not endangered
requirements.text: The dual control unit shall be fitted outside the driver's cabin in a position where the operator is not endangered by trailer movement and can see the danger area between the vehicles at a glance.

requirements.quote: It must not be possible to lock the control unit in the operating position or operate it unintentionally.
requirements.text: It shall not be possible to lock the control unit in the operating position or to operate it unintentionally.

requirements.quote: The movement of the trailer shall take place without jolting, at a speed of not more than 50 mm/sec.
requirements.text: Movement of the trailer produced by the CCD shall take place without jolting and at a speed not exceeding 50 mm/s.

requirements.quote: Release of a control must stop the movement immediately.
requirements.text: Release of a control shall stop the movement of the CCD immediately.

requirements.quote: Forward movement of the towing vehicle shall not result in rearward movement of the trailer in relation to the road surface.
requirements.text: Forward movement of the towing vehicle shall not result in rearward movement of the trailer relative to the road surface.

requirements.quote: Rearward movement of the trailer of not more than 30 mm is permitted only for switch and react purposes.
requirements.text: Rearward movement of the trailer shall be permitted only for switch and react purposes and shall not exceed 30 mm.

requirements.quote: The CCD must return to its shortest normal straight ahead operating position following relative angular movement between towing vehicle and trailer, in accordance with annex 4.
requirements.text: The CCD shall return to its shortest normal straight-ahead operating position following relative angular movement between towing vehicle and trailer, in accordance with Annex 4.

requirements.quote: Operation of the CCD shall not interfere with the dynamic stability of the combination. This requirement shall be checked during the tests described in annex 4.
requirements.text: Operation of the CCD shall not interfere with the dynamic stability of the combination, as checked during the tests of Annex 4.

requirements.quote: The CCD shall be designed so as to enable the vehicles to be coupled or uncoupled. All coupling operations shall be automatic, including the mechanical controls
requirements.text: The CCD shall be designed to enable the vehicles to be coupled and uncoupled, with all coupling operations, including the mechanical controls and parts subject to towing or steering forces, being automatic.

requirements.quote: Correct engagement of the positive locking system must be indicated or be easily visible from the side of the vehicle alongside the coupling device.
requirements.text: Correct engagement of the positive locking system shall be indicated or easily visible from the side of the vehicle alongside the coupling device, otherwise a remote indication shall be installed in the driver's cabin.

requirements.quote: Manual coupling of control and power supply lines is permitted provided the connections are readily accessible from a standing position
requirements.text: Where control and power supply lines are coupled manually, the connections shall be readily accessible from a standing position and the combination shall be safely drivable without these lines connected.

requirements.quote: Semi-trailer horizontal ± 90°
requirements.text: When engaged with a semi-trailer, the CCD shall provide at least ±90° of horizontal angular movement.

requirements.quote: vertical ± 12°
requirements.text: When engaged with a semi-trailer, the CCD shall provide at least ±12° of vertical angular movement.

requirements.quote: For hydraulic or pneumatic CCD's, an optical signal shall indicate that the CCD is about to reach its maximum extension.
requirements.text: When a hydraulic or pneumatic CCD approaches its maximum extension, an optical signal shall indicate this to the driver.

requirements.quote: The CCD shall be designed such that when coupling at an angle between the towing vehicle and trailer different from that when uncoupled
requirements.text: The CCD shall be designed so that coupling at an angle between towing vehicle and trailer different from the uncoupling angle does not cause unintentional trailer movement or incorrect functioning.

requirements.quote: A plate specifying the maximum mass of the towing vehicle and the trailer, all lubrication points and the frequency of lubrication shall be affixed
requirements.text: A plate specifying the maximum mass of the towing vehicle and trailer, all lubrication points and the lubrication frequency shall be affixed such that it is clearly visible even when the trailer is coupled.

requirements.quote: There shall be securely affixed to every CCD conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place
requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be securely affixed to every CCD in a conspicuous and readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: The approval mark shall include a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country that granted the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the CCD shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min
requirements.text: The characters forming the approval mark on the CCD shall have a minimum dimension a of 8 mm.

requirements.quote: Full retraction of the CCD must have taken place within 150 metres from the acceleration start position
requirements.text: When the combination is driven from a straight-ahead position around a 12.5 m outside-radius bend, stopped at 90° yaw and accelerated to 30 ± 2 km/h, full retraction of the CCD shall have taken place within 150 m from the acceleration start position.

requirements.quote: This test shall be conducted in both left and right directions.
requirements.text: The CCD recovery distance test shall be conducted in both the left and right directions.

requirements.quote: The technical service shall verify that some retraction of the CCD takes place all the time the towing vehicle is moving forward.
requirements.text: Some retraction of the CCD shall take place the whole time the towing vehicle is moving forward.

requirements.quote: The vehicles must be laden, the distribution of mass among the axles being that stated by the manufacturers of the vehicles
requirements.text: For the stability test, the vehicles shall be laden with the axle mass distribution stated by the vehicle manufacturers.

requirements.quote: The height of the centre of gravity of the vehicles shall be at least 1.7 metres.
requirements.text: For the stability test, the height of the centre of gravity of the vehicles shall be at least 1.7 m.

requirements.quote: The test must be carried out at the speeds prescribed for each type of test.
requirements.text: The stability tests shall be carried out at the speeds prescribed for each type of test.

requirements.quote: The tests must be performed when there is no wind liable to affect the results.
requirements.text: The stability tests shall be performed when there is no wind liable to affect the results.

requirements.quote: At the start of the tests, the tyres must be cold and at the pressure prescribed by the manufacturer of the vehicles or tyres
requirements.text: At the start of the stability tests, the tyres shall be cold, at the manufacturer-prescribed pressure for the actual load, and substantially new.

requirements.quote: The prescribed performance must be obtained without self amplifying reactions, without deviation of the vehicles from their course, and without unusual vibration in the steering and coupling system.
requirements.text: The prescribed stability performance shall be obtained without self-amplifying reactions, without vehicle deviation from course and without unusual vibration in the steering and coupling system.

requirements.quote: Vehicles shall be tested at a speed of 85 +5/-0 km/h and remain aligned.
requirements.text: In the straight-line stability test, the combination shall be tested at 85 +5/-0 km/h and remain aligned without unusual steering correction.

requirements.quote: An emergency straight line braking test from a speed of 60 km/h to rest at a mean fully developed deceleration of at least 4 m/s2
requirements.text: In an emergency straight-line braking test from 60 km/h to rest at a mean fully developed deceleration of at least 4 m/s2, the combination shall not deviate outside a 3.5 m wide lane.

requirements.quote: Starting from rest, a forward acceleration of at least 2 m/s2 shall not cause any movement between the vehicles
requirements.text: Starting from rest, a forward acceleration of at least 2 m/s2 shall not cause movement between the vehicles of a degree likely to cause the driver difficulty in controlling the combination.

requirements.quote: No permanent deformation shall take place during the above tests.
requirements.text: No permanent deformation of the CCD shall occur during the straight-line stability and braking tests.

requirements.quote: A simulated overtaking manoeuvre, as defined in the appendix, conducted at a progressively increasing speed up to 80 km/h
requirements.text: A simulated overtaking manoeuvre conducted at progressively increasing speed up to 80 km/h shall not cause the driver any difficulty in controlling the combination.

requirements.quote: At a speed of 20 km/h steering from one side of the track to the other alternately at least 3 times
requirements.text: When steering from one side to the other alternately at least 3 times at 20 km/h on a 10 m track, no contact between the vehicles and no damage to the CCD shall occur.

requirements.quote: the combination shall be driven around a curve of 25 m radius to a speed of 20 km/h at an acceleration of 2 ± 10% m/s2
requirements.text: When driven from rest around a 25 m radius curve to 20 km/h at 2 ± 10% m/s2, no movement between the vehicles shall occur that could cause the driver difficulty in controlling the combination.

requirements.quote: the rearmost outer edge of the trailer, travelling at a speed of 25 km/h ± 1 km/h, shall not move outside the circle described
requirements.text: In the circular movement test at 25 km/h ± 1 km/h, the rearmost outer edge of the trailer shall not move more than 0.70 m outside the circle described at a constant 5 km/h.

requirements.quote: No part of the trailer must move more than 0.5 m beyond the tangent to a circle with a radius of 25 m
requirements.text: No part of the trailer shall move more than 0.5 m beyond the tangent to a 25 m radius circle when towed out of the circle along the tangent at 25 km/h, from the tangent point to 40 m along the tangent.

requirements.quote: Any motor vehicle or combined vehicle which is in motion must be able to turn within a swept circle having an outer radius of 12.50 m and an inner radius of 5.30 m.
requirements.text: The vehicle combination in motion shall be able to turn within a swept circle of 12.50 m outer radius and 5.30 m inner radius, in both left and right directions.

requirements.quote: No part of the combination, where it penetrates the circle from a tangent, may overlap that tangent by more than 0.8 m
requirements.text: No part of the combination penetrating the swept circle from a tangent shall overlap that tangent by more than 0.8 m beyond the point of intersection.

requirements.quote: There shall be no unintentional contact between any part of the towing device and the towing vehicle or trailer when the vehicles are positioned at a relative vertical angle of 6°.
requirements.text: When the vehicles are positioned at a relative vertical angle of 6° in line and in normal operating position, there shall be no unintentional contact between any part of the towing device and the towing vehicle or trailer.

requirements.quote: No contact shall occur between the bodies of the towing vehicle and trailer at a relative vertical angle of 5°.
requirements.text: No contact shall occur between the bodies of the towing vehicle and semi-trailer at a relative vertical angle of 5°.

requirements.quote: The acoustic device must be located in the driver's cabin and must be easily audible by the driver under all circumstances, when the vehicle is in normal use.
requirements.text: The acoustic warning device for the CCD shall be located in the driver's cabin and be easily audible by the driver under all circumstances in normal use.

requirements.quote: The optical signal shall be red in colour and located on the instrument panel in the direct field of vision of the driver
requirements.text: The optical warning signal shall be red in colour, located on the instrument panel in the driver's direct field of vision, and easily visible even in daylight.

requirements.quote: Coupling and uncoupling must be possible with coupling angles of up to 50° horizontally both to the right and left
requirements.text: Coupling and uncoupling shall be possible at coupling angles of up to 50° horizontally to the right and left without intervention of additional personnel.

requirements.quote: up to 7° when twisted axially in both directions
requirements.text: Coupling and uncoupling shall be possible at up to 7° of axial twist in both directions without intervention of additional personnel.

requirements.quote: The temporary position must permit the combination to be safely manoeuvred.
requirements.text: Where a temporary position is arranged before final coupling, that temporary position shall permit the combination to be safely manoeuvred.

requirements.quote: If the final action is operated manually the space between the vehicles must be at least 500 mm.
requirements.text: If the final coupling action is operated manually, the space between the vehicles shall be at least 500 mm.

requirements.quote: It must be possible from the standing position for one person to position the coupling devices prior to the coupling procedure without the use of tools.
requirements.text: It shall be possible for one person, from a standing position and without tools, to position the coupling devices prior to coupling and to connect and disconnect the braking and electrical lines.

requirements.quote: The requirements of Section I, paragraph 5.1., excluding paragraph 5.1.12. have to be fulfilled when the CCD is fitted to the vehicle
requirements.text: When the CCD is fitted to the vehicle, the requirements of Section I paragraph 5.1, excluding 5.1.12, shall be fulfilled despite influences caused by vehicle operation.

requirements.quote: The CCD in use shall not impede the movement of the vehicles to which it is fitted.
requirements.text: The CCD in use shall not impede the movement of the vehicles to which it is fitted, as verified by the Annex 4 test requirements.

requirements.quote: in accordance with annex 4
requirements.text: The return of the CCD to its shortest straight-ahead operating position shall be demonstrated in accordance with the recovery-distance test of Annex 4, paragraph 1.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle
requirements.text: The tractor unit and its electrical/electronic systems or ESAs shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that, in normal conditions of use, the vehicle complies with the EMC requirements of UN R10.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: Any ESA fitted to the tractor unit shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a 10.0 ± 0.2 m antenna spacing, vehicle broadband radiated emissions shall not exceed 32 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz, a logarithmically rising 32 to 43 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz, and 43 dBµV/m from 400 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a 3.0 ± 0.05 m antenna spacing, vehicle broadband radiated emissions shall not exceed 42 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz, a logarithmically rising 42 to 53 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz, and 53 dBµV/m from 400 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: On the vehicle representative of its type, all broadband radiated emission values shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a 10.0 ± 0.2 m antenna spacing, vehicle narrowband radiated emissions shall not exceed 28 dBµV/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 35 dBµV/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When measured at a 3.0 ± 0.05 m antenna spacing, vehicle narrowband radiated emissions shall not exceed 38 dBµV/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 45 dBµV/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a radiated field strength of 30 V/m over more than 90% and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz band, and 10 V/m over more than 90% and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: in accordance with ISO 11451-4 BCI the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: When tested by the ISO 11451-4 BCI method, the vehicle shall withstand 60 mA over more than 90% and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.text: During the immunity tests, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity-related functions of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
requirements.text: For an ESA, broadband radiated emissions shall not exceed 62 to 52 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz decreasing logarithmically, 52 to 63 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz increasing logarithmically, and 63 dBµV/m from 400 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically
requirements.text: For an ESA, narrowband radiated emissions shall not exceed 52 to 42 dBµV/m from 30 to 75 MHz decreasing logarithmically, 42 to 53 dBµV/m from 75 to 400 MHz increasing logarithmically, and 53 dBµV/m from 400 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: Positive +150 V
requirements.text: For an ESA on a 24 V system, transient conducted emissions on the supply lines shall not exceed a positive pulse amplitude of +150 V.

requirements.quote: Negative -450 V
requirements.text: For an ESA on a 24 V system, transient conducted emissions on the supply lines shall not exceed a negative pulse amplitude of -450 V.

requirements.quote: BCI 20 to 400 MHz
requirements.text: For an ESA tested by BCI over 20 to 400 MHz, the immunity test level shall be 60 mA over more than 90% of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: ALSE 80 to 2,000 MHz
requirements.text: For an ESA tested in an ALSE over 80 to 2,000 MHz, the immunity test level shall be 30 V/m over more than 90% of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: 50 mA
requirements.text: For an ESA tested by BCI, the minimum immunity test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz band shall be 50 mA.

requirements.quote: 25 V/m
requirements.text: For an ESA tested in an ALSE over 80 to 2,000 MHz, the minimum immunity test level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz band shall be 25 V/m.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.text: During the ESA immunity tests, there shall be no degradation of performance of the immunity-related functions.

requirements.quote: 1 -450 V 500 pulses
requirements.text: For an ESA on a 24 V system, immunity to test pulse 1 shall be demonstrated at -450 V with 500 pulses.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses
requirements.text: For an ESA on a 24 V system, immunity to test pulse 2a shall be demonstrated at +37 V with 500 pulses.
For an ESA on a 24 V system, immunity to test pulse 3a shall be demonstrated at -150 V for 1 hour.
For an ESA on a 24 V system, immunity to test pulse 3b shall be demonstrated at +150 V for 1 hour.

requirements.quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses
requirements.text: For an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases on a 24 V system, the starting profile shall be applied at test level II with 10 pulses.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: An approval mark shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under UN R10.

requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form
requirements.text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place on each vehicle or ESA specified on the approval communication form.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The ESA sample submitted for approval shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3. above need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
requirements.text: The approval marking on an ESA need not be visible once the ESA is installed in the vehicle.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The characters forming the approval mark shall have a minimum dimension a of 6 mm.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE)
requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements in an ALSE or OTS.

requirements.quote: 120 kHz 20 s/MHz
requirements.text: When quasi-peak measurements are made with a spectrum analyser, the resolution bandwidth at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz and the minimum scan time 20 s/MHz.

requirements.quote: 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz
requirements.text: When peak measurements are made with a spectrum analyser, the resolution bandwidth at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz.

requirements.quote: 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms
requirements.text: When making peak measurements with a scanning receiver, the bandwidth at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.
requirements.text: Radiated emission measurements shall be made on both the left and right sides of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The ignition switch shall be switched on. The engine shall not be operating.
requirements.text: For narrowband radiated emission measurement, the ignition switch shall be on and the engine shall not be operating.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: Narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: During the immunity test, the vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation from 20 to 6,000 MHz in vertical polarization.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: In the 20 to 400 MHz range, the immunity test signal shall be amplitude modulated at 1 kHz with 80% modulation depth.

requirements.quote: PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: In the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz range, the immunity test signal shall use PM2 modulation with Ton 3 µs and period 3,333 µs.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h
requirements.text: For the vehicle immunity test, the engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h.

requirements.quote: Vehicle speed 50 km/h (respectively 25 km/h for L1, L2 vehicles) ±20 per cent
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test mode, the vehicle speed shall be maintained at 50 km/h ±20%, and a speed variation greater than ±10% of nominal speed shall be a failure.

requirements.quote: Dipped beams ON (manual mode) Lighting OFF (front light and rear light)
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test mode, dipped beams shall be ON in manual mode and lighting OFF shall be a failure criterion.

requirements.quote: Direction indicator on driver's side ON
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test mode, the driver's side direction indicator shall be ON, and a frequency change outside 0.75 to 2.25 Hz shall be a failure.

requirements.quote: Brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle.
requirements.text: In the brake immunity test mode, the brake pedal shall be depressed to activate the brake function and stop lights without any dynamic cycle.

requirements.quote: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle.
requirements.text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle during the immunity tests.

requirements.quote: the length of the Low Voltage (LV) harness and the HV harness parallel to the front edge of the ground plane shall be 1,500 mm (±75 mm)
requirements.text: For ESA emission testing, the LV and HV harnesses parallel to the ground plane front edge shall be 1,500 mm ±75 mm, the total harness length 1,700 mm (+300/-0) mm, and the LV-HV separation 100 mm (+100/-0) mm.

requirements.quote: DC HV supply shall be applied to the ESA via a 5 μH/50 Ω HV-AN
requirements.text: For an ESA with a DC HV supply, the supply shall be applied through a 5 µH/50 Ω HV-AN, and an AC supply through a 50 µH/50 Ω AMN.

requirements.quote: All of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1.4), at 50 mm (±5 mm) above the ground plane.
requirements.text: All harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive material of relative permittivity ≤ 1.4 at 50 ± 5 mm above the ground plane.

requirements.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via defined impedance.
requirements.text: The ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via a defined impedance.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: Before or after the main emission test, the extraneous ambient noise shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: ESA narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2
requirements.text: ESAs may be tested for immunity by an absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, provided the full 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range is covered.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.text: ESA immunity measurements shall be made from 20 to 6,000 MHz with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The ESA absorber chamber immunity test shall be performed with vertical polarization.

requirements.quote: injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: When the BCI substitution method is used, the injection probe shall be positioned 150 mm from the ESA.

requirements.quote: injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: When the BCI closed-loop method is used, the injection probe shall be positioned 900 mm from the ESA.

requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2
requirements.text: Test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the ESA supply lines and to other connections that may be operationally connected to the supply lines.

requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines
requirements.text: The starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the ESA supply lines and other operationally connected connections.

requirements.quote: For an ESA powered by LV, a 5 µH / 50 Ω AN as defined in Figure 1 shall be used.
requirements.text: For an ESA powered by low voltage, the test shall use a 5 µH/50 Ω artificial network as defined in Figure 1 of Appendix 8.

requirements.quote: The AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane. The grounding connection of the AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.
requirements.text: The artificial network shall be mounted directly on the ground plane, and its grounding connection shall be bonded to the ground plane.

requirements.quote: Measurement ports of AN(s) shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
requirements.text: Measurement ports of the artificial networks shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.

requirements.quote: The HV-AN impedance ZPB (tolerance ± 20 %) in the measurement frequency range of 0,1 MHz to 100 MHz is shown in Figure 2.
requirements.text: The HV artificial network impedance ZPB shall be within ±20% of the characteristic shown in Figure 2 over 0.1 to 100 MHz.

requirements.quote: For a vehicle/ESA in charging mode connected to an AC power mains, a 50 µH / 50 Ω-AMN as defined in CISPR 16-1-2 Clause 4.4 shall be used.
requirements.text: When a vehicle or ESA is tested in charging mode connected to AC power mains, a 50 µH/50 Ω AMN as defined in CISPR 16-1-2 Clause 4.4 shall be used.

requirements.quote: It provides a common mode impedance of 150 Ω ± 20 Ω (150 kHz to 30 MHz) on the control pilot line
requirements.text: The AAN used on a control pilot line with PLC shall provide a common mode impedance of 150 Ω ± 20 Ω from 150 kHz to 30 MHz.

requirements.quote: Temporary loss of charging function is allowed, provided that there is no incorrect charging condition
requirements.text: During ESA immunity testing in charging mode, temporary loss of the charging function shall be allowed only if no incorrect charging condition occurs and the function can be restored without tools after the disturbance is removed.
